tools.name: get_operation
tools.description:
Poll the native Serverless operation ID returned by submission.

        This never submits, reconnects or replays work. The same ID identifies
        the job in Scientific AI and the Serverless console.
        Includes measured scientific progress such as completed ns and ns/day,
        separately from acknowledged checkpointed work. Missing/stale values
        are explicit; GPU, instance and runtime placement details stay private.

tools.name: get_operation_result
tools.description:
Read a completed native operation's verified result and artifacts.

        Use the same operation ID returned by submission, not another alias.

tools.name: cancel_operation
tools.description: Request native cancellation; a request is not GPU settlement.

tools.name: start_isaac_interactive_session
tools.description:
Start one GUI/teleoperation session from an owned Isaac project artifact.

        Upload the project first; never put archive bytes or credentials here.
        A session ID is an admission, not proof of rendered frames. Open the
        browser handoff and authenticate the same owner. Reconnect uses this
        session ID and preserves its original deadline; never resubmit science
        after a lost acknowledgement or interrupted browser connection.

tools.name: get_isaac_interactive_session
tools.description: Read the same native session and separately observed media readiness.

tools.name: attach_isaac_interactive_session
tools.description: Get a same-owner browser handoff; never create or renew a native session.

tools.name: stop_isaac_interactive_session
tools.description: Request native cancellation; output drain and resource release are separate.

tools.name: get_isaac_interactive_result
tools.description: Read verified recording and receipt artifacts without restarting simulation.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Discover caller-authorized Apps; discovery is not a runtime-readiness claim.

tools.name: list_scientific_models
tools.description: List the caller's available scientific Apps and exact runtime/schema capabilities.

tools.name: get_tool_catalog_revision
tools.description: Return this caller's exact visible tool-schema revision; refetch tools/list on change.

tools.name: get_model_schema
tools.description: Get the selected App's exact native fields, artifact transport and execution limits.

tools.name: submit_gromacs_workflow
tools.description:
Run native GROMACS preparation, molecular dynamics and analysis on one GPU.

        Supply an immutable gromacs-inputs gzip-tar artifact manifest and typed
        native command steps. The supplied scientific protocol is not rewritten.
        Returns an operation ID, NOT finished simulation output. Identical retries
        must reuse idempotency_key. Native checkpoints survive GPU replacement.
        This migration pilot accepts one job per call; make separate calls for replicas.

tools.name: submit_gromacs_mpi_workflow
tools.description:
Run one native multi-GPU GROMACS workflow on a configured MPI shape.

        Upload an immutable gromacs-inputs gzip-tar manifest, or the exact
        continuation_files map of retained native files. The selected node/GPU
        shape must match the App schema's configured capabilities. Returns a
        durable operation ID, not completed simulation output. Reuse the same
        idempotency_key after a lost response; poll get_operation and
        retrieve get_operation_result. Native .cpt recovery is not GPU snapshotting.

tools.name: acknowledge_operation
tools.description:
Purge a terminal operation's stored inference request/response payload.

        Save required results first. This is destructive, not a status poll:
        inference result tools return410 afterwards. Separately published
        scientific artifacts and native checkpoints are not deleted.

tools.name: get_scientific_checkpoints
tools.description: Inspect the latest acknowledged native checkpoint; local-only files are not durable.

tools.name: resume_scientific_run
tools.description:
Resume this owner-held scientific job from its last committed native checkpoint.

        MD/scVI returns a new operation ID; a staged App retains its graph ID and
        continues only the bound failed member. Cancelled graphs cannot resume.
        The original immutable engine/runtime profile
        remains authoritative. Native continuation guarantees differ by engine;
        this is not bitwise or GPU process-state restoration. Reuse the same key
        on retries. Use only an originally approved GPU class.

tools.name: retry_scientific_delivery
tools.description:
Retry delivery of completed scientific files using CPU only, without rerunning MD.

        Use after a completed calculation could not upload its final outputs.
        Poll the SAME operation ID. Only the model's fixed transfer command is
        permitted; failed scientific computation cannot be promoted to success.
        Reuse idempotency_key on network retries. Serverless bounds retries and
        cancellation. Unconfigured deployments return a capability error.

tools.name: begin_scientific_artifact_upload
tools.description: Reserve an immutable input. Transfer bytes using returned HTTPS URL, then finalize.

tools.name: finalize_scientific_artifact_upload
tools.description: Verify exact input bytes/checksum and obtain the immutable reference for a manifest.

tools.name: multipart_scientific_artifact_upload
tools.description:
Start or resume a large owner-scoped artifact upload without inline bytes.

        Use the reservation's upload_id. Start returns its durable multipart ID;
        list discovers transferred parts, parts issues short-lived bounded PUT
        handles, complete assembles S3's actual part ETags, and abort cancels only
        that upload. Keep the same IDs after disconnect or response loss. Complete
        is not finalization: call finalize_scientific_artifact_upload to verify the
        entire reserved SHA-256. Do not send inference bearer keys to object URLs.

tools.name: get_scientific_artifact
tools.description: Get metadata and an authenticated download path; never return raw trajectory bytes.

tools.name: download_scientific_artifact
tools.description:
Get an exact artifact's short-lived GET handle; no bearer header is needed at that URL.

        The handle expires within 60 seconds. Do not log or share it. Revocation
        after issuance can take until expiry; no raw file bytes enter MCP.

tools.name: lookup_mdprecheck
tools.description:
Look up an earlier mdprecheck for the same immutable inputs/options without running it.

        If found, the completed result and report references are returned directly. A scientific fail/warn
        remains a completed check, not permission to repeat it or modify inputs.

tools.name: genmol_generate
tools.description: Generate de-novo molecules using a SAFE mask-token minimum, not heavy-atom bounds; returns generated SMILES and property scores. De-novo mask [*{minimum-maximum}], with 1 <= minimum <= maximum <= 512. The adapter passes floor((minimum + maximum) / 2) as upstream min_add_len, a minimum number of SAFE mask tokens; [*{10-20}] therefore reports minimum_mask_tokens=15. Upstream samples token length from its empirical distribution above that minimum. Neither endpoint is a heavy-atom bound, and maximum is not a maximum token or molecular-size limit. Measure and filter heavy-atom counts on returned SMILES separately if required. Range order and finite numeric strings are checked by the runtime.  Durable operation: submit once with an idempotency key; poll get_operation, then get_operation_result. Transfer failures retry delivery without rerunning inference. Use private immutable artifact references for files.

Unknown endpoint names are errors. Use small-molecule structures, not protein sequences; review applicability and assay definitions. Durable operation: submit once with an idempotency key; poll get_operation, then get_operation_result. Transfer failures retry delivery without rerunning inference. Use private immutable artifact references for files.

Only file mode is available through this tool; live speech is not exposed by this gateway.  Durable operation: submit once with an idempotency key; poll get_operation, then get_operation_result. Transfer failures retry delivery without rerunning inference. Use private immutable artifact references for files.

tools.name: infer_magpie_tts_multilingual_357m_native
tools.description: Generate complete WAV audio using one of five named Magpie v2607 voices. Large output is returned through a tenant-owned artifact handle. Use /v1/voice/synthesize for incremental audio. Only file mode is available through this tool; live speech is not exposed by this gateway.  Durable operation: submit once with an idempotency key; poll get_operation, then get_operation_result. Transfer failures retry delivery without rerunning inference. Use private immutable artifact references for files.
